Winwood Dental — SEO audit

Clear issues, real evidence and focused fixes.

51 sitemap URLs · 51 distinct HTML pages · read-only · October 7

01

Unrelated treatments promote veneers

Emergency and General Dentistry show a shared appointment message about dental veneers instead of the treatment being viewed.

  • Replace the shared sidebar message with neutral appointment wording or correct page-specific copy; review the 21 unrelated source candidates.
02

The homepage loads a 20 MB animation

The first-screen background is a 20 MB animated WebP with 261 frames, adding avoidable media weight.

  • Use a smaller quality-preserving video with a lightweight poster, or a static mobile version.
  • Retest the mobile text LCP separately; this animation is not its verified LCP element.
03

Small photo cards use a 1 MB original

A 1 MB office photo appears on 26 pages, including homepage cards displayed at roughly 318×255 and 82×65 pixels.

  • Serve properly cropped responsive image sizes and lazy-load off-screen instances; preserve the original and visual quality.

Fix order

Correct the shared treatment message, then reduce media weight while preserving quality.

  • Website/content: shared sidebar and responsive media changes.
  • SEO: retain correct business data and use filtered Google reports; minor schema details stay in the wider report.

Large downloads are not automatically the LCP cause. Two wrong sidebar examples are visibly verified; the wider report retains all source candidates and Google-data limits. No live changes.
